faqs.q: What is the value-back offered by Axis Pride Signature Credit Card through reward points?
faqs.a: Since each reward points can be redeemed in 5:1 ratio, you can get a value-back worth 0.80% on your card spends through rewards.

faqs.q: How often can I apply the dining discount benefit using my Axis Pride Signature Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can use the dining discount once every month using your Axis Pride Signature Credit Card.

faqs.q: Is there any spending condition associated with the complimentary domestic lounge access using Axis Bank Pride Signature Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can avail the domestic airport lounge visits by spending at least Rs. 50,000 in the previous quarter.

faqs.q: Is Axis Pride Signature Credit Card lifetime-free?
faqs.a: No, Axis Pride Signature comes at zero joining fee, but it charges a renewal fee of Rs. 500 + taxes. However, you can waive off this renewal fee if you spend a min. of Rs. 40,000 in a year.
